newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle seen steady-firm - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle seen steady-firm - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets Monday were seen steady, with a firm tone, amid ideas that showlists will have tight supplies of market-ready cattle, feedlot sources said.
Sources said Friday's bearishly-construed USDA Cattle on Feed Report should have little impact on the cash market Monday, as packers and feedyards focus on the currently tight supply of fed cattle.
Many of the cattle on this week's showlists reportedly were sold, leaving few carryovers into next week, sources said.
